assets.prompt: Redrawn at 2x detail (two art pixels a world pixel, drawn at half size in the game) from its 1x art with the same layout, frames and silhouette: its diagonals smoothed to one-pixel steps and its outside outline one art pixel thick, then given new detail at the finer pixels: each material's surface (bone pitted with pores, wood grain in broken streaks along each part's length, light flecks on leaf and fire, glints on ice, gold and lightning, speckle on stone and void, the same in every frame of a strip) and a one-pixel lit edge on each part's top-left and a shaded one on its bottom-right (Stone kept at its base there); palette colours only. The 1x art's prompt: The Crypt Mite, a horde swarmer: a round knot of dark staff Wood broken out of an old crypt staff, scuttling on four thin root-legs, with a little Bone ferrule. Small and squat (about 10x10 px of body) so hundreds read as a swarm; its one eye floats on the knot. A 32x32 body with its ferrule at the bottom (row 28), 1px dark outline, light from the top-left; the face (eye and brow) is a separate layer. Only non-overlapping rect elements, whole-number coordinates, palette colours from docs/STYLE.md; no player colours.
